# IBM Plex

Unmodified TTF files from the official IBM releases:

- IBM Plex Sans 3.005 (`@ibm/plex-sans@1.1.0`, `ibm-plex-sans.zip`, `fonts/complete/ttf/`): Regular, Medium, SemiBold
- IBM Plex Mono 2.004 (`@ibm/plex-mono@1.1.0`, `ibm-plex-mono.zip`, `fonts/complete/ttf/`): Regular

https://github.com/IBM/plex/releases

License: the releases' `LICENSE.txt`, here `OFL.txt` (SIL Open Font License 1.1).
Embedded only in tool interfaces (`ToolUi/`); never linked into a game's runtime. The license text is embedded with
the fonts and available through `ToolFontLicense()`.
